title: Key Housing Project Bonds Restructured
summary:
*   Approved a financial restructuring plan for the Woodmead Apartment Project, a multi-family housing development.
*   This "workout" addresses financial challenges related to housing revenue bonds originally issued in 1985.
*   The resolution for the bond workout passed unanimously among the board members present for the vote.
